description: Schedule a one-time wake-up after a delay, keyed by a memory tag (memory_tag). If you include both memory_tag and content, the scheduling plugin will stash content as a tagged memory automatically (one-step pattern). When the wake-up fires, the platform retrieves memories tagged with memory_tag (via get_memories_by_tag) and the model decides what to do next. Typical uses: progress check-ins, timeouts, simple polling loops, and "always-on" ticks. memory_tag is commonly also used as the schedule tag for cleanup (clear_scheduled_actions_by_tag).
embedding_description: Schedule a wake-up in N seconds using memory_tag. Optional content enables one-step pattern: stash follow-up instructions as a tagged memory + schedule the wake-up in the same call. Wake-up retrieves memories with that tag (get_memories_by_tag) and the model decides. Use for check-ins, timeouts, polling, self-rescheduling ticks. Cleanup via clear_scheduled_actions_by_tag.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation of one-time delayed execution with schedule_id, delay time, and run_at timestamp
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: A delayed execution schedule has been created. Consider whether you should inform the requester when the check-in/reminder will occur, and retain the schedule_id or tags so it can be cancelled or replaced once underlying work completes.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Scheduling a one-time delayed wake-up keyed by memory_tag
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError with 'seconds': delay must be a positive integer. ValidationError with 'memory_tag': memory_tag is missing or invalid. SchedulerError: scheduling service unavailable or failed to register schedule.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For seconds errors: provide a positive integer for the delay. For memory_tag errors: provide a non-empty memory_tag and ensure the follow-up memory is tagged with it. For scheduler errors: verify the scheduling service is running.
